record.paper_title: Some open problems in Banach space theory
record.original_question: Let X be a Banach space that is Lindelöf in its weak topology. Must X be isomorphic to a subspace of a weakly compactly generated Banach space?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Let X be a (real or complex) Banach space, and consider X equipped with its weak topology σ(X, X*). Recall that a topological space is Lindelöf if every open cover admits a countable subcover, and that a Banach space Y is called weakly compactly generated (WCG) if there exists a weakly compact subset K ⊆ Y whose linear span is norm-dense in Y. Assume X is Lindelöf in its weak topology. Must X be isomorphic to a closed subspace of some WCG Banach space?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a longstanding problem in nonseparable Banach space theory. Surveys and works by Argyros–Mercourakis, Kalenda, and Fabian–Godefroy–Montesinos–Zizler discuss closely related classes (WLD, σ-Asplund generated, Lindelöf Σ in weak topology), and counterexamples are known showing that subspaces of WCG need not be WCG and that some WCD spaces are not subspaces of any WCG space. However, the search did not locate a definitive resolution (positive or negative) of the precise question as stated for Banach spaces that are Lindelöf in their weak topology, so its current status is reported as unknown.

status_evidence.title: On Weakly Lindelöf Banach Spaces (Argyros–Mercourakis)
status_evidence.snippet: Study of weakly Lindelöf Banach spaces and their relationship to WCG / WLD classes.
status_evidence.claim: The class of weakly Lindelöf Banach spaces has been actively studied but the precise embedding-into-WCG question is treated as a fundamental open question.

status_evidence.title: WCG space — Encyclopedia of Mathematics
status_evidence.snippet: There are WCD spaces which are not isomorphic to subspaces of any WCG space; closed subspaces of WCG spaces need not be WCG.
status_evidence.claim: Counterexamples exist in larger classes (WCD), but the specific weakly Lindelöf case is not resolved by these results.

status_evidence.title: WCG spaces and their subspaces grasped by projectional skeletons
status_evidence.snippet: Subspaces of WCG spaces are characterized within WLD as σ-Asplund generated spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Modern characterizations of subspaces of WCG do not settle whether weakly Lindelöf alone forces embeddability into WCG.
